description: MainActivity class for an Android Notes application, managing UI components, search, and navigation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main entry point activity for the notes app, managing note list UI, filtering, and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up event listeners, populates category filter.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes categories and notes display when activity resumes.

methods.name: setupCategoryFilter
methods.description: Populates the category filter spinner with categories from the repository.

methods.name: filterAndShow
methods.description: Filters notes based on search query and selected category, updating the list view.
